    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Matches the 'TX fees and policy' label and directly modifies fee estimation under src/policy/fees/.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents severe fee underestimation and unnecessary RPC errors by falling back to block policy estimates when the mempool estimator is unready. Downstream consumers like LDK encountered cases where mempool estimation failed despite block estimates being fully available, prompting a backport nomination."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to src/rpc/fees.cpp are minor adjustments to reflect fee estimation return values rather than changes to RPC interface machinery.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Excluded because modifying the data returned by estimatesmartfee is the domain of fee policy, which the RPC merely exposes."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "The few lines touched in src/init.cpp merely clear fee estimator stats during startup mempool load failure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Excluded because changes in init.cpp are purely secondary wiring for fee estimation lifecycle management."
    }
